positive_set.definition: tool name matches a read-verb prefix AND description contains tier keywords (co-occurrence candidates for tuning, NOT verdicts)
positive_set.read_name_rule: name (case-insensitive) starts with a read verb followed by '_', '-', a digit, an uppercase letter (camelCase), or end-of-name; manual check because IGNORECASE breaks character-class boundaries

comma_gap.definition: descriptions where a read-verb lead is followed by a comma and a state-change verb inside the same sentence (the #101 reproduction population)
